tools.disambiguation: Cancels an EXISTING voucher, voiding it. To create one use jde.ap.voucher.create; to read one first use jde.ap.voucher.get; to find one by supplier or date use jde.ap.voucher.search.
tools.lexicalDocument: Cancel a voucher Cancel an AP voucher, voiding the open payable it created. void a voucher reverse a voucher cancel a supplier invoice voucher JD Edwards — Accounts Payable jde Accounts Payable jde ap voucher cancel

tools.disambiguation: Creates a NEW voucher. To find existing vouchers use jde.ap.voucher.search; to read one use jde.ap.voucher.get; to reverse one use jde.ap.voucher.cancel.
tools.lexicalDocument: Create a voucher Create an AP voucher against a supplier, optionally matched to a PO. supplier invoice enter a bill AP invoice entry book a payable voucher JD Edwards — Accounts Payable jde Accounts Payable jde ap voucher create

tools.disambiguation: Reads ONE existing voucher by document number and changes nothing. To find vouchers by supplier, date or amount use jde.ap.voucher.search; to create one use jde.ap.voucher.create; to void one use jde.ap.voucher.cancel.
tools.lexicalDocument: Get a voucher Read one AP voucher by document number, type and company. read a voucher look up an invoice voucher detail voucher JD Edwards — Accounts Payable jde Accounts Payable jde ap voucher get

tools.disambiguation: Finds vouchers by supplier, date or amount when you do not know the document number. To read one known voucher use jde.ap.voucher.get; to create one use jde.ap.voucher.create; to void one use jde.ap.voucher.cancel.
tools.lexicalDocument: Find AP vouchers Search AP vouchers by supplier, GL date, pay status or document type. find vouchers supplier invoice search AP voucher lookup voucher JD Edwards — Accounts Payable jde Accounts Payable jde ap voucher search
Check batch status Return a batch's approval, post status and out-of-balance flag. batch status is this batch posted batch JD Edwards — General Ledger jde General Ledger jde fin batch get status

tools.disambiguation: Creates a NEW unposted journal batch and stops there. To post it use jde.fin.journal.submit; to find existing journals use jde.fin.gl_journal.search; to read a batch's post status use jde.fin.batch.get_status.
tools.lexicalDocument: Create a GL journal Create an unposted GL journal batch against an account. enter a journal entry book a JE GL entry journal voucher entry journal JD Edwards — General Ledger jde General Ledger jde fin journal create

tools.disambiguation: Posts an EXISTING unposted batch created by jde.fin.journal.create — it never creates one. To read a batch's current post status use jde.fin.batch.get_status; to find the batch use jde.fin.gl_journal.search.
tools.lexicalDocument: Post a GL journal batch Post an existing unposted GL journal batch to the ledger. post a journal submit a batch for posting post the JE journal JD Edwards — General Ledger jde General Ledger jde fin journal submit

tools.disambiguation: Approves an EXISTING purchase order. To raise a new one use jde.scm.purchase_order.create; to check what has been received against one use jde.scm.purchase_order.get_receipt_status.
tools.lexicalDocument: Approve a purchase order Approve a purchase order, releasing it to the supplier. approve a po release purchase order sign off a po purchase_order JD Edwards — Procurement jde Procurement jde scm purchase order approve

tools.disambiguation: Creates a NEW purchase order. To approve one that already exists use jde.scm.purchase_order.approve; to check what has been received against one use jde.scm.purchase_order.get_receipt_status.
tools.lexicalDocument: Raise a purchase order Create a purchase order for a supplier against a business unit. raise a po create purchase order issue a po place an order purchase_order JD Edwards — Procurement jde Procurement jde scm purchase order create

tools.disambiguation: Reads an EXISTING purchase order and changes nothing. To raise a new one use jde.scm.purchase_order.create; to approve one use jde.scm.purchase_order.approve.
